summary: Transform your approach to rural development with our training course. Learn to build resilient livelihoods and support sustainable community initiatives.
lede: Rural development and resilient livelihoods planning involves assessing community assets, vulnerability, and feasible income pathways. For professionals who plan, deliver, monitor, or fund rural programmes, the course develops practical skills in participatory appraisal, climate-risk screening, and value-chain analysis. Learners also use resilience indicators, results frameworks, and digital field-data workflows to design interventions and track change, with human and community validation informing analysis.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who plan, deliver, monitor, or fund rural development and resilient livelihoods initiatives. It suits foundation to intermediate learners who need practical planning tools and does not require advanced economics, programming, or geospatial expertise.
prerequisites: You need access to a laptop for spreadsheet exercises and digital planning templates. The course provides sample rural household data, case materials, livelihood assessment templates, vulnerability matrices, value chain mapping tools, Theory of Change and Logical Framework templates, and resilience reporting formats. Advanced GIS, statistical programming, and production-grade AI implementation are outside the course scope.
